meta.conceptLabel: 雨の窓辺 — 日本シニア低温ヒーリング
meta.tempoPolicy: 62-66 BPM only. Never raise BPM to shorten duration.
meta.energyPolicy: Playlist-wide energy ceiling 2.2/5. No designated upbeat track, no big emotional high point, no sudden density jump, no full-band chorus blast.
meta.genrePolicy: Quiet 1970s Japanese New Music, soft Kayokyoku and acoustic Folk only. Showa Groove, funk-soul drive, bright brass-led kayokyoku and dance pulse are removed.
meta.lyricPolicy: Metaphor-led poetic Japanese. No direct family-role narration, no childish address, no explanatory emotional conclusion. Each song uses one central concrete image or object and real sensory detail.
meta.vocalPolicy: Mature low-mid chest voices, calm neutral expression, narrow melodic range, almost straight tone, tiny delayed vibrato. No youthful brightness, smiley theatrical delivery, belt, falsetto climax, octave lift, kobushi excess or shouted ad-lib.
meta.arrangementPolicy: Maximum four clearly audible primary instruments at once. Drums absent on most tracks; when used, only feather-light brushes. Core palette: piano, acoustic or nylon guitar, cello/viola, clarinet/bass clarinet, restrained bass.
meta.transitionPolicy: Track-to-track loudness, spectral brightness, vocal presence and arrangement density remain close. Choruses widen only 8-12% over verses.
meta.durationPolicy: 44-48 effective bars, compact three-scene lyric form, one 4-bar instrumental break, no long coda, no extra final refrain.
meta.revisionNoteKo: 원본의 80~100 BPM, Showa Groove, 강한 후렴 고점과 킬링포인트 설계를 폐기하고 001~003 최신 기준과 같은 저에너지 일본 시니어 채널 문법으로 15곡 전체를 재작성했다. 비·젖은 유리·수증기·종이·금속 같은 감각 이미지를 세트의 공통 결로 삼았다.
